description: bihgrid: the Bosnia and Herzegovina transmission grid as a graph learning dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Faruk Dziho (University of Texas at San Antonio). Real ≥220 kV transmission topology of Bosnia and Herzegovina (40 BA buses + 11 border buses, 62 lines with electrical parameters, from the PyPSA-Eur OSM prebuilt network) joined with 11+ years of hourly ENTSO-E zone-level time series (load, generation per production type, forecasts, cross-border physical flows and scheduled exchanges with HR/RS/ME), plus a curated plant-to-bus ... Coverage: national (BA); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is OTHER-OPEN. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
